content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> P2: tenant-specific quality regression: tenant `helios-data` on dedicated pool `us-west-3-ded-1`. Signal: custom_eval.bleu_drop = -15.2 after quant rollout `q6_experimental_v1`. Runbook: /runbooks/tenant-quant-issues. Paging oncall.

oncall-ray: ack. I'm on. Mira, Hao start triage. Diego/Lina standby for customer comms. Any recent rollouts to that pool?

mira (SRE): quick glance: new quant rollout executed at 2026-10-02T01:12Z to pool `us-west-3-ded-1` targeting profile `q6_experimental_v1`. Alerts start at 01:14Z. No infra alerts (no reboots, no GPU OOMs).

hao (ML infra): model: `red-11b` with profile `q6_experimental_v1`. Telemetry shows a collapse in generated token diversity for helios prompts: many one-word answers, early stop, and high repetition. Log diagnostics: altered softmax temperature due to per-block scaling in q6; KV-index offsets look off for certain head groups.

lina (Support): customer sample (redacted):

```
User: "Write a 300-word summary of Q3 telemetry and recommended actions"
Expected: ~300 words with structured bullets and metrics.
Observed: "Summary." (one word)
```

diego (Acct Exec): customer is pinging our CS channel and says their assistant "lost its ability to write properly". Need ETA to restore, will tell them we're on it.

mira (SRE): mitigation choices:
1) revert the pool rollout (affects all tenants on that pool)
2) create a tenant routing override to previous stable profile (surgical)
3) enable on-request float fallback for helios (expensive)

hao (ML infra): fastest low-blast option is a tenant route override. We can pin `helios-data` to `red-11b@v2.7.9` with `int8_compat` profile. That should restore pre-rollout behavior immediately.

mira (SRE): command to create override:

```
redwoodctl routes create-override --tenant helios-data --model red-11b --version v2.7.9 --profile int8_compat --reason "emergency revert: quality regression"
```

ops-bot: executing `routes create-override` -> job id j-6b2c. Propagating changes.

oncall-ray: issuing override now. Hao, monitor eval stream and sample outputs. Mira, scan pool for other tenants impacted.

ops-bot: route override active for tenant `helios-data`. Traffic being routed to `red-11b@v2.7.9` with profile `int8_compat`.

hao (ML infra): running live checks. Preliminary metrics:
- baseline bleu (helios eval): 78.4
- after rollout (issue): 63.2
- after override (T+30s): 77.9
Sample outputs look restored on quick check.

lina (Support): customer confirms "looks like it's back, thanks" on an informal test. They want written confirmation and a timeline for a permanent fix.

diego (Acct Exec): I'll tell them we applied a targeted fix and are preparing a postmortem. Need ETA for a full remediation.

mira (SRE): running a pool-wide sweep. So far, 1 other tenant shows minor blip (delta ~ -0.05) but nothing meeting alert threshold. Looks isolated to helios so far.

hao (ML infra): initial RCA hypothesis: `q6_experimental_v1` introduced a per-head quant scaling table that interacts poorly with `red-11b` attention geometry when prompts include long structured lists. The grouped scaling reduces dynamic range of tail logits and triggers premature stop conditions in our sampling code path. Also saw mismatches between kernel selection for KV-cache warmup leading to stale cache reads for some request shapes.

oncall-ray: immediate plan:
- keep tenant override active for 2 hours while we run extended validation across helios eval-suite.
- Hao to prepare reproduction case and test patch for quant scaling.
- Mira to set alerts and sweep other tenants on the pool for similar prompt distributions.
- Do not revert the whole pool yet since blast radius is higher.

mira (SRE): created sweep job and set watch on bleu_drop > 8 for pool tenants. Also saved telemetry snapshot -> s3://redwood-telemetry/incidents/2833333333/snapshot.tar.gz

ops-bot: telemetry snapshot saved.

hao (ML infra): proposed mitigations and ETA:
- Short-term: keep override + manual canary of q6 changes with tuned scaling table -> ETA 6-12 hours for a tested patch and canary.
- Medium-term: add tenant-simulated preflight tests to rollout pipeline and an opt-out flag `skip_experimental_quant` -> ETA 24-48 hours.
- Long-term: rework quant math for per-head scaling to preserve tail logits while keeping perf -> ETA 3-7 days depending on kernel work.

lina (Support): customer asked whether opt-out is available now. Diego: tell them opt-out will be available within 36 hours; we will confirm sooner if we can expedite.

diego (Acct Exec): noted. I'll send that update and request temp credits for the customer due to SLA impact.

mira (SRE): follow-up: no other tenants breached thresholds in initial sweep. Leaving override active and monitoring. Filing postmortem ticket PM-2833333333 and assigning Hao for ML follow-ups and me for deployment process.

ops-bot: created postmortem ticket PM-2833333333 -> https://tracker/internal/PM-2833333333

oncall-ray: handing watch to Mira for next 3 hours. If override holds, we'll close incident as mitigated and move to P3 pending postmortem. Great work team.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated by tenant route override. Severity downgraded to P3 pending postmortem.

diego (Acct Exec): will follow up with customer tomorrow with the postmortem link. Please include timeline, root cause, and mitigations.

hao (ML infra): I'll post reproduction steps and a draft remediation plan in PM-2833333333 within 24h.

mira (SRE): closing handoff. Over and out.
notes: isolated tenant regression caused by experimental per-head quant scaling; tenant override used to mitigate; postmortem and opt-out planned
